title: Gateway PoP type does not enforce challenge issuance or one-time freshness
description: Security review finding: VerifiedGatewayIdentity::verify accepts both presented_challenge and expected_challenge as caller-provided byte arrays and only checks equality/nonzero. There is no gateway challenge issuer, outstanding-challenge registry, expiry, peer binding, or one-use consumption; tests simply pass the same static array for both. A captured proof can therefore be reconstructed into a fresh VerifiedGatewayIdentity indefinitely by any caller and fed to admit_gateway, despite the type/documentation claiming a verifier-issued fresh proof. Replace the raw expected argument with an opaque challenge capability issued by a bounded nonce manager, bind it to the enrollment/session and expiry, and consume it exactly once before producing VerifiedGatewayIdentity; add replay/expiry/cross-session negatives.
